name: budget-exceeded-terminal
description: A run budget of 770,000,000 nanos rides on the user_input. Each attempt first reserves its model-declared bound (765,360,000). The first fits; after it settles at 6,000,000 the second reservation would reach 771,360,000, so budget_exceeded is recorded before any request exists and the turn ends budget_exhausted. Reservation before dispatch means no response can overshoot.
